summary: Keep. Town page + SRPA park page + 2026 guide (accredited): 17 full-service 30 A + 13 water/15 A sites, showers, flush toilets, dump; reservations by phone/email, otherwise FCFS; season May long weekend-Sep 30. Fees newly written ($40/$45 without sticker, $30/$35 with; entry $5/day). No seasonal sites advertised (weekly is the longest rate) - nightly. Not waterfront kept; pin OK.
flags: FEES: none stored -> nightly_low 40 / high 45 CAD (sticker-free rates; $30/$35 with a regional park season sticker), entrance {5,5,vehicle_day}. The SRPA page does not say whether the $5 daily entry is charged on top of the sticker-free camping rate.
SEASON: opens 05-15 kept (2026 Victoria Day weekend begins May 15), closes 09-30 confirmed; method -> manual. 2027 not out.
NIGHTLY SHARE: no seasonal rate or seasonal sites posted anywhere (longest rate weekly) - treated as all nightly. No Let's Camp listing.

WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept. Notukeu Creek is ~15-20 m wide (creekside at most); imagery shows a few units parked on a track along the creek's north bank (~49.7495,-107.4876) and a gravel area with a service building west of the pool (~49.7495,-107.4893), but no site map or site numbers are published, so no site can be named within 50 m.

PIN: stored 49.74820,-107.48680 sits at the pool beside the campground; SRPA GPS 49.74883,-107.48889 is a lane junction ~165 m WNW. Camping area not resolvable on imagery; both within ~150 m - left alone.
PHONE 306-625-3222 (town office) and both websites confirmed.
